visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman with black hair styled in two playful buns adorned with red pom-pom accessories. She is wearing a light-colored kimono-inspired wrap jacket with traditional Japanese patterns including flowers and birds over a pair of short white athletic shorts. She holds a black microphone in her left hand and performs rhythmic, sharp punching motions towards the camera while maintaining a bright, cheerful facial expression with a wide smile. (2) The camera switches to a profile view from her right side. She is standing on a dark stage surface in a sports stadium, which is clearly identifiable by the green chain-link fence and the expansive green grass of the baseball field in the background. She continues her high-energy choreography, performing a series of dynamic arm extensions and retractions that sync perfectly with the driving electronic music, her body swaying rhythmically with each beat. (3) The woman turns her back to the viewer, revealing the "RAKUTEN MONKEYS" logo and text printed on the rear of her patterned jacket. She continues to dance with intensity, her white sneakers and knee-high socks flashing as she shifts her weight and points her right finger in various directions. The outdoor setting is brightly lit by natural daylight, emphasizing the vibrant colors of her outfit and the stadium environment. (4) Turning back to face the camera, she continues her repetitive dance routine. A yellow banner with the large black numerals "196" and the text "WE ARE NINE SIX" is prominently visible behind her on the stage. In the final moments, a male figure wearing a white and maroon baseball uniform with "RAKUTEN" on the front walks across the background behind her just before the scene fades to black.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-tempo electronic dance music (EDM) track begins immediately, characterized by a heavy, resonant kick drum and sharp snare hits at approximately 130 BPM. The music has a bright, energetic tone with synthesized melodic layers in a major key. There is a faint, continuous bed of outdoor ambient noise and the muffled sound of a distant crowd cheering and applauding, which provides a sense of a large-scale live event atmosphere without any intelligible speech. (2) The rhythmic EDM continues with high intensity, maintaining a consistent percussive drive. Each quarter-note beat is accented by a clean, electronic impact effect that simulates a clap or a hit, mirroring the dancer's sharp movements. The spectral balance is weighted toward the high-mid frequencies, giving the music a piercing, upbeat quality. The professional recording shows high clarity with minimal distortion, even during the heavy bass transients of the electronic drums. (3) As the video nears its conclusion, the background crowd noise—consisting of collective cheering and high-pitched vocal outbursts—becomes slightly more prominent in the mix. The electronic music remains the primary signal, maintaining its energetic tempo until it is abruptly cut off at the end of the clip. The transition is a hard technical cut, with the natural room tone of the stadium environment fading out alongside the music.
